name: Viewarr
description: Backups of your Viewarr setup, kept on your Dispatcharr (Viewarr → Settings → Users & profiles → Backups).
author: petebutty

fields.label: What this is
fields.help_text: Viewarr keeps backups of an admin's whole setup here (settings and sign-ins, the sign-ins encrypted with the admin's own Dispatcharr key). Save and restore them from Viewarr: Settings → Users & profiles → Backups. Only admins can reach them.
